similarityReview: The 3D model accurately captures the sleek, aerodynamic profile of the motor yacht. The hull is constructed using a wedge for the bow and a box for the main body, with a secondary blue-colored facade layer. The cabin and windshield are modeled with glassHex components, and the canopy is represented by a box structure. Bilateral symmetry was applied to ensure the port and starboard sides are identical, and all components are watertight with appropriate offsets to prevent Z-fighting.
